stem: Which quotation best conveys the author's message?

options.label: A
options.text: "The blind man's music was enchanting. After he finished his song, I left him a few coins, expecting to continue on my way."

options.label: B
options.text: My grandfather knew that if he wasn't willing to part with his precious heirlooms, his family might go hungry. It was a sacrifice he was willing to make.

options.label: C
options.text: Each night when my grandfather took out the valuable pieces that he planned to sell the next day, he would describe to me why he loved them.

options.label: D
options.text: "I probably paid far more than it was worth because I emptied out my pockets and gave the blind man all my cash."
